zh: 科廷大学（Curtin University）成立于1966年，位于澳大利亚西澳大利亚州首府珀斯，是澳大利亚科技大学联盟成员，在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第183位，全澳排名上升1位，位列全澳第12位。学校在采矿工程领域全球排名第2，毕业就业率高达92%，是澳洲留学性价比最高的隐藏王牌之一。学校以实践为导向的教学理念和与行业紧密结合的课程设置，为学生提供了丰富的实习和就业机会。
en: Curtin University, founded in 1966, is located in Perth, the capital of Western Australia, Australia. It is a member of the Australian Technology Network of Universities, ranked 183rd in the QS World University Rankings 2026, rising 1 place in Australia to 12th nationally. The university ranks 2nd globally in Mining Engineering with a 92% graduate employment rate, making it one of the most cost-effective hidden gems for studying in Australia. Its practice-oriented teaching philosophy and industry-integrated curriculum provide students with abundant internship and employment opportunities.
